messages:
Jake Lin: RPTech just pinged — INV-9023 shows a large Dedicated overage after an automatic failover. Can finance take a look?
Maya Patel: sending to billing ops. can you attach the invoice line and any quick usage ranges?
Jake Lin: invoice snippet: 
  LineItem: DEDICATED_BURST
  Period: 2026-03-15
  ReservedCommit: 1,200,000 token-hours
  BurstUsage: 3,400,000 token-hours
  Charge: $18,450
Priya Rao: which meter id? we need per-node metering to reconcile — also whether cross-region failover is covered by their plan.
Jake Lin: tagging the account owner: @Aisha — can you confirm what happened on 2026-03-15 and how long the failover lasted?
Aisha Rahman (RPTech): yep — our EU prod cluster lost connectivity to the regional DB and our app triggered the auto-failover to us-west. It lasted ~1h45m. Raw usage export below (redacted):
```
2026-03-15T02:13:22Z, node-eu-1, 120000 tokens
2026-03-15T02:17:03Z, node-usw-2, 980000 tokens
2026-03-15T03:58:40Z, node-usw-2, 110000 tokens
```
we didn't intentionally burst, it was traffic rerouting.
billing-bot: Alert: Dedicated burst threshold exceeded for account rptech (acct_id: rptech-prod) at 2026-03-15T02:14:18Z — generated charge estimate: $18,450
Luis Gomez: CS note: RPTech told our AE they assumed reserved commit would cover failover. They were surprised by the charge.
Maya Patel: quick policy note: reserved commit is applied to the account across regions but does not "pause" charging when cross-region failover occurs — traffic still consumes burst pool. we do have a discretionary first-time incident credit for production failovers, subject to reconciliation.
Priya Rao: action items: 1) export per-instance meter logs for 03/15 01:50–04:00 UTC; 2) map token counts to invoice hashes; 3) determine whether this fits the one-time discretionary credit. I'll open a ticket and attach artifacts.
Jake Lin: propose provisional goodwill credit of $6,000 while we do the recon, pending no signs of policy circumvention. thoughts?
Maya Patel: +1 to provisional credit of $6k if logs show auto-failover and no config to intentionally shift load. Priya, escalate to legal if you see repeated cross-region spikes in prior 30 days.
Priya Rao: opened ticket BILL-2026-987 and uploaded the usage CSV + meter IDs. pinging @billing-bot to attach meter export.
billing-bot: Attached: /exports/rptech/usage-2026-03-15.csv (processed).
Meter IDs included: node-eu-1, node-usw-2, node-usw-3
Aisha Rahman (RPTech): thanks — appreciate the quick temporary credit. we'll share our incident postmortem and timeline once it's ready.
Luis Gomez: we'll also offer a config review with Solutions so they can see options to avoid cross-region billing surprises (regional routing, warm standby sizing etc.)
Jake Lin: recon ETA ~48 hours. I'll update the invoice once Priya confirms final numbers. Thanks all :thumbsup:
